meta.name: Generate multi-platform social captions from blog posts with OpenAI

name: Blog to Social Media Captions, Copy and Paste Generator

parameters.content:
## Blog to Social Media Captions

Paste a blog URL or blog text into a form and get ready to copy captions for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, YouTube Community, and Reddit, plus alt text for the featured image. Built for bloggers, marketers, and small teams who want to promote one post everywhere without rewriting it eight times by hand. Nothing gets posted automatically, you copy and paste each caption yourself.

### How it works
1. **Blog Input Form** collects a blog URL, or pasted blog text, plus an optional image URL.
2. **Has Blog URL?** checks which field was filled in and picks the right path.
3. **Fetch Blog Page** downloads the page and **Extract Article Text** strips it to clean text. **Use Pasted Content** handles the manual paste path instead.
4. **Build Prompt** writes clear per platform instructions for the AI model.
5. **Generate Captions** calls the AI model and returns one JSON object with every caption.
6. **Build Copy-Paste Page** turns that JSON into a styled page with copy buttons, shown to you by **Show Captions**.

### Setup steps
1. Open node 8, OpenAI Chat Model, and connect your own OpenAI credential.
2. Activate the workflow.
3. Open the Production URL on node 1, Blog Input Form, and test it with a real blog post.

### Customization
Swap the OpenAI Chat Model node for Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, or Ollama, the AI Agent works with any of them. Edit the prompt inside Build Prompt to change tone, caption length, or hashtag count per platform.

## 1. Input and routing
Blog Input Form collects the blog URL, pasted text, and image URL. Has Blog URL? checks which one was filled in and routes to the right path.

## 2. Fetch and extract content
Fetch Blog Page downloads the URL and Extract Article Text strips it to clean text. Use Pasted Content handles the manual paste path instead.

## 3. Generate captions with AI
Build Prompt writes platform by platform instructions. Generate Captions, powered by the OpenAI Chat Model, returns one JSON object with every caption.

## 4. Build and deliver the page
Build Copy-Paste Page turns the AI output into a styled page with copy buttons. Show Captions displays it to the user.

options.systemMessage:
You are a social media content strategist. You write platform-native captions that sound human, never templated.

You always respond with a single valid JSON object and nothing else. No markdown code fences, no preamble, no explanation before or after the JSON.
